study: V99 R45 pure adaptive net cap
objective: retain fixed defensive R30 and directly cap excessive portfolio net exposure with an opposite BTC hedge, using only R39 chronologically validated net-absolute thresholds and no additional market-timing condition
grid_policy: 27 predeclared combinations = 3 fixed net triggers x 3 target net caps x 3 maximum hedge bounds
disclosure: Historical research only. Net exposure is known at close t and alters only the next requested target. Trigger thresholds were fixed from R39 first chronological 60% before this grid. No real-order path is enabled. Any historical winner requires frozen forward paper.
